title: Fairness at Every Intersection: Uncovering and Mitigating Intersectional Biases in Multimodal Clinical Predictions

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating Demographic Parity (DP), True Positive Rate (TPR), and Worst-case Parity (WP) across intersectional demographic subgroups formed by combined race and gender identities (e.g., Asian-Female, Black-Male) in multimodal clinical prediction tasks.

Measuring algorithmic fairness metrics (Demographic Parity, True Positive Rate) across distinct racial categories (White, Black, Asian, Non-White) to evaluate disparities in medical prediction models.
Measuring algorithmic fairness metrics (Demographic Parity, True Positive Rate) across gender categories (Male, Female) to evaluate disparities in medical prediction models.
